ingredients: 500 g chicken | 45 ml soy sauce | 45 ml vinegar | 4 cloves garlic | 1 piece onion | 2 pcs bay leaf optional
instructions: Prepare chicken and aromatics. | Combine soy sauce, vinegar, garlic and chicken. | Simmer until cooked through and tender. | Reduce sauce to preferred consistency. | Serve warm.

ingredients: 500 g chicken | 30 g ginger | 3 cloves garlic | 1 piece onion | 1 piece sayote | 1 cup malunggay leaves | 20 ml fish sauce optional
instructions: Prepare ingredients. | Saut ginger, garlic, and onion. | Add chicken and cook briefly. | Add water and simmer until chicken is cooked. | Add sayote and malunggay; season to taste.

ingredients: 500 g chicken | 3 cloves garlic | 1 piece onion | 200 ml tomato sauce | 2 pieces potato | 1 piece carrot | 1 piece bell pepper optional
instructions: Prepare and chop vegetables. | Saut garlic and onion. | Brown chicken lightly. | Add tomato sauce, potatoes, and carrots. | Simmer until chicken and vegetables are cooked.

ingredients: 2 pieces eggplant | 2 pieces egg | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Roast eggplants until soft. | Peel and flatten carefully. | Beat eggs. | Dip eggplants in beaten eggs. | Pan-fry until fully cooked.

ingredients: 250 g rice | 350 g chicken | 25 g ginger | 5 cloves garlic | 1 piece onion | 2 pieces egg optional
instructions: Wash rice. | Saut aromatics. | Add chicken and rice. | Add water and simmer until tender. | Season and serve.

ingredients: 300 g mung bean sprouts | 3 cloves garlic | 1 piece onion | 1 piece carrot | 150 g tofu optional | 20 ml soy sauce optional
instructions: Wash vegetables. | Saut garlic and onion. | Add carrots. | Add sprouts and optional tofu. | Season and serve.

ingredients: 2 cups rice | 5 cloves garlic | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Use cooked, cooled rice. | Heat oil and fry minced garlic. | Add rice and toss until hot. | Season lightly and serve.

ingredients: 600 g pork | 2 pieces tomato | 1 piece onion | 1 bunch kangkong | 1 piece radish | 1 pack tamarind mix
instructions: Simmer pork until tender. | Add onions and tomatoes. | Add tamarind souring agent. | Add vegetables in order of cooking time. | Season and serve hot.
